DESIGN PHASE COMPLETE — all 5 stage design docs authored + each grounded in real verus, committed (907f1e6 Stage 1; bf45312 Stages 2-5). Under .design/basis/:
- 01-adts.md — recursive ADTs + pattern matching (struct/enum/Box-recursive/match). Box<T> on the Alloc effect (resolved). 8 verified.
- 02-recursion-schemes.md — fold/map/traverse, induction-discharged-once (fold_bound). 8 verified.
- 03-effect-stdlib.md — effect-lattice atoms as contracted seccomp-confined #[boundary] primitives. 2-3 verified. Finding: --no-cheating bans external_body -> legitimate-boundary vs core-cheat is mechanically checkable.
- 04-collections.md — bounded Vec/Map + capacity/element invariants on Box/Alloc. 5 verified. Lowerer note: needs final(self).
- 05-composition.md — capstone; 4 laws (contract+aggregation SHIPPED via #52/#15/#60, scheme-fusion + invariant-conjunction NOT-STARTED). 4-5 verified.

Dependency chain: 1 is the keystone (2/4/5 build on it). BUILD SEQUENCE (the remaining work, each a doc-author-refine -> builder -> critic loop): Stage 1 first (the ADT type system unblocks everything). Notable open design questions for the build: exec folds monomorphized vs higher-order (S2 OQ); boundary contracts exempt from the §7 weak-ens vacuity reject (S3 OQ, the honesty seam); wrap-vstd-Vec vs custom backing (S4 OQ); whether S5 REQ-4/REQ-7 reduce to conformance tests given #52's reachable_fn_deps already weaves transitive deps (S5 OQ). Epic stays OPEN for the build phases.
